titulo.alumno:
«Движение и падеж после предлога»
Movement with place and destination

intro: The destination usually takes the accusative: в парк, на работу; the origin, often the genitive with из, с or от.

piezas.titulo: The destination usually takes the accusative: в парк, на работу; the origin, often the genitive with из, с or от.
texto: The destination usually takes the accusative: в парк, на работу; the origin, often the genitive with из, с or от.
Compare: в офисе (location), в офис (destination), из офиса (origin).
